name: dialog
purpose: Modal dialog built on native <dialog>.showModal(): top layer, inert background, focus containment, with deterministic Escape/backdrop policy, focus restoration, scroll lock, and cancelable close events.
whenToUse: Tasks that must be completed or dismissed before returning to the page.
whenNotToUse: Non-blocking information: use an inline message, alert, or toast.
Complex multi-step flows better served by a page or wizard.
Contextual content anchored to a trigger: use a popover.
responsive: Width min(size token, 100vw - 2rem); max height 100dvh - 2rem with a scrolling body. Below 480px, footer actions stack full-width.
rtl: Logical properties throughout; close button sits at the inline end.
theme: Surface, border, radius, shadow and backdrop tokens. Forced-colors mode uses CanvasText borders.
security: Title, description, and string content are rendered as text; never parsed as HTML. CSP-safe.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: Nested dialog stacking is native; tested with one dialog containing a combobox.

limitations: Pressing Escape in a focused combobox with a value but closed listbox clears the combobox first (per APG) instead of closing the dialog.
Close animation is not played; the open transition uses @starting-style and is removed under reduced motion.
Initial focus follows the native dialog focusing steps: an action with `autofocus: true`, otherwise the first focusable element (the close button when shown).
unsupported: Rendering HTML strings as content (pass a Node instead).
antiPatterns: Enabling closeOnBackdrop for dialogs containing unsaved input without handling aui-cancel.
Stacking many dialogs; prefer a single dialog with changing content.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/dialog: AuiDialog directive (ng-template[auiDialog]) with an [open] input; the template is the dialog body.
